en: Sepia-toned vintage photograph mounted on a postcard backing, depicting a small rural church with a tall steeple and simple rectangular nave, surrounded by trees and open fields. In the foreground, three women in long dresses and aprons and one man with a bicycle stand in the grassy field in front of the church. There are a few scattered farm buildings in the distance. The borders are blank and slightly worn, with no visible printed caption.
